title: Habitual use of GPS negatively impacts spatial memory during self-guided navigation
authors: Louisa Dahmani and Véronique D. Bohbot
locator: PDF p. 2 Participants; pp. 10–11 follow-up; p. 12 caution about small sample and spurious correlations

title: GPS use and navigation ability: A systematic review and meta-analysis
publisher: Journal of Environmental Psychology / University of Padua repository
authors: Laura Miola, Veronica Muffato, Enrico Sella, Chiara Meneghetti and Francesca Pazzaglia
locator: PDF pp. 2–3 methods and inclusion; p. 8 section 3.3 pooled r and confidence intervals; pp. 10–11 strengths/limitations; p. 1 license
appraisal: 23 studies reviewed, 18 pooled; mixed experimental/cross-sectional designs, small pooled relationships, substantial heterogeneity and bias concerns. Includes Dahmani 2020, so the two sources are not independent replications. No general-reasoning or brand-specific estimate.
